Lucas (CS): Heads up — Shoreline pay usage down ~52% month-over-month. Renewal in 6w. Champion Anya left last month; procurement now with Marcus (VP Finance).
Priya (AE): Any incidents or prod blockers?
Lucas (CS): They reported intermittent inference timeouts last week, then paused embeddings batch job 4/12. No enablement calls since onboarding.
Sam (Solutions): I checked traces: spike in model queue latency 4/10-4/12 due to misconfigured batching window. Patch was suggested but not applied.
Marta (Ops): Their stack still on runtime 2.0 with default batching=500ms. Recommend reduce to 100ms and enable prefix cache. I'll prepare patch.
Priya (AE): Marcus mentioned in last convo they're evaluating cheaper embedding provider for batch-heavy workflows.
Lucas (CS): Risk = lost champion + batching issues impacting cost/perf = procurement leverage. Proposed rescue actions below.
Priya (AE): 1) Ops hotfix to batching config (Marta) 2) Quick health demo + cost comparison call (Lucas/Priya) 3) Offer 2-week Dedicated burst at reduced rate + 15% usage credit 4) Request short pilot addendum with commit by renewal date.
Marta (Ops): I'll push config change to their env and run smoke tests. ETA 12h.
Sam (Solutions): I'll assemble a one-pager showing perf before/after and token cost delta (two representative queries).
Priya (AE): Commercial will draft credit proposal. Legal to review pilot amendment.
Lucas (CS): I'll ask Anya's replacement for 30m tomorrow; goal: show fix, share dashboard, present credit.
billing-bot: Invoice alert: Shoreline scheduled invoice due in 10 days (auto-reminder sent).
Priya (AE): Owners: Ops fix (Marta) - 12h, Perf one-pager (Sam) - 18h, Call booked by EOD (Lucas/Priya) - schedule, Commercial draft (Priya) - 36h.
Lucas (CS): Logging next steps in CRM under stage: rescue. Please post brief updates here.
Marta (Ops): Patch deployed to staging, smoke tests pass. Will target production in next maintenance window and follow-up with notes. :white_check_mark:
Lucas (CS): Thanks team. If Marcus still leans competitor after the call, escalate to VP Sales for executive outreach.
